user.title: Log in to tado
user.description: Open {url} (code: {code}), approve access, then select Submit.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to tado again
reauth_confirm.description: tado rejected the saved login. Open {url} (code: {code}), approve access, then select Submit.

error.not_authorised: Login has not been approved yet. Approve it in the browser, then submit again.

abort.auth_failed: Authentication failed or expired. Start again.
abort.no_homes: No homes found on this account.
abort.wrong_account: This login does not have access to the configured home.

resume_schedule.name: Resume schedule
resume_schedule.description: Removes the manual override and resumes the smart schedule for the selected rooms.

resume_all_schedules.name: Resume all schedules
resume_all_schedules.description: Resumes the smart schedule in every room of every configured home.

set_room_temperature.name: Set room temperature
set_room_temperature.description: Sets a target temperature with a chosen termination.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Minutes; required for a timed override.

boost_all_rooms.name: Boost all rooms
boost_all_rooms.description: Boosts heating in every room for 30 minutes (tado X only).

turn_off_all_rooms.name: Turn off all rooms
turn_off_all_rooms.description: Switches heating off in every room until the next schedule block.

api_unreachable.title: tado is not responding
api_unreachable.description: Home Assistant has been unable to read from tado for over an hour. Check your internet connection and the tado status page; the integration retries automatically.

init.title: Options
init.description: Polling and override behaviour. The boost settings apply to the climate Boost preset; the whole-home boost uses tado's own settings.
